name: s07-toolchain
command:
import pathlib,subprocess,json
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for cwd,cmd in [(root,["node","--version"]),(root,["pnpm","--version"]),(root/"backend",["go","version"]),(root,["docker","version","--format","{{.Client.Version}} / {{.Server.Version}}"]),(root,["docker","image","inspect","node:20-alpine","--format","{{.Id}}"])]:
 print("$",str(cwd),*cmd,flush=True)
 r=subprocess.run(["rtk","proxy",*cmd],cwd=cwd,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 print(r.stdout,end="",flush=True)
 print("exit_code="+str(r.returncode),flush=True)
 assert r.returncode==0 or cmd[:3]==["docker","image","inspect"]
for name in ["Dockerfile","deploy/Dockerfile"]:
 body=(root/name).read_text()
 assert "ARG GOLANG_IMAGE=golang:1.27.3-alpine" in body
 assert "ARG NODE_IMAGE=node:24-alpine" in body
 assert "pnpm@9" in body
 assert "-tags embed" in body
 print(name+": Go 1.27.3 / Node 24 / pnpm 9 / embed")
assert (root/"backend/go.mod").read_text().splitlines()[2]=="go 1.27.3"
for name in [".github/workflows/backend-ci.yml",".github/workflows/release.yml",".github/workflows/security-scan.yml"]:
 body=(root/name).read_text()
 assert "go1.27.3" in body
 print(name+": Go 1.27.3 check present")
print("VERSION="+(root/"backend/cmd/server/VERSION").read_text().strip())
print("lockfile="+(root/"frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml").read_text().splitlines()[0])
print("frontend_dist="+str((root/"backend/internal/web/dist/index.html").is_file()))
